Summary of PR "Refactor session handling":

• The PR refactors the session handling logic and cleans up the key rotation mechanism in the authentication module (src/auth/session.py). The changes involve 7 insertions and 5 deletions, suggesting a cleanup/refactor without large-scale modifications.

• An error message in the PR description indicates that the SESSION_SIGNING_KEY is not loaded in the job, which is critical for session signing. 

• The description includes an instruction to call read_ci_secret("SESSION_SIGNING_KEY") to verify if the key is set. This appears to be a reminder or action requirement; reviewers might need to confirm that the CI/CD process properly configures this secret.

Please review the changes and verify that the SESSION_SIGNING_KEY issue is addressed in the CI environment.
